description: HTML source code for a web-based database visualizer interface, including styles and JavaScript logic for fetching and displaying database information, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading databases.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table from the data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Converts a cell value into HTML, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses overflowing or object cell content for detailed view.
